QuestInfo.name: The Broker Knows
QuestInfo.0: #bHan the Broker#k wants to see you in Magatia.
QuestInfo.1: Han the Broker has offered you the missing piece of your stolen research puzzle, IF, and only if, you pay him #b10,000 mesos#k.
QuestInfo.2: Once you forked over the 10,000 mesos, Han explained that a group of highly-trained individuals entered Magatia just before the disappearance of the forbidden research. They were deterred at first, but brought in #bsomeone that appeared to be their leader#k. That person spoke with #bBedin#k, in the Zenumist's #b#m261010000##k.

0.0: Good day to you. I am #bHan the Broker#k, the person you should have come to if you were looking for information in Magatia.
0.1: I happen to have a a piece of very #bpertinent information#k that neither the Zenumist nor Alcadno stiffs would share with you. Interested?

yes.0: But I don't make a habit of give things away for free.
yes.1: It's a simple proposal. Give me #b10,000 mesos#k, and I will give you my #bvaluable information#k.

no.0: You're not being very smart. I make my living trading in information like this.
no.1: I would normally charge you just to hear my initial spiel, but I will make an exception today.

yes.0: By now, you've heard about the missing research, I'm sure. The Zenumists and Alcadnos would each love to believe the others were at fault, but that job was not performed by amateurs. The thieves were #btrained professionals#k.
yes.1: But what you may not know is that those thieves failed at first. The documents were protected by a very #bsecretive enchantment#k that the underlings were unable to crack.\r\n#bThat's why they called in their boss#k.
yes.2: The boss arrived, and the documents were gone. It's quite clear to any level-headed person that neither the Zenumists nor the Alcadno had anything to do with the robbery.
yes.3: Yet both sides insist it was the other, because who else could have broken such a powerful enchantment?
yes.4: The culprit must have been skilled, and definitely came from outside. Even I, the repository of information, could not find a way to break that spell.
yes.5: Interestingly enough, the #bboss#k met up with #bBedin#k, one of the Zenumists. I would recommend you pay him a visit in #b#m261010000##k.
yes.6: That's all the talking you've paid me for. Our business is at an end.

quest.0: I do not offer discounts. #b10,000 mesos#k, or no deal.
